items.title: Timex Group India posts Rs 800 crore revenue for FY26
items.description: Timex Group India achieved a landmark financial year 2025-2026. Revenues surged 48% to Rs 800 crore, with profit before tax jumping 151% to Rs 107.4 crore. EBITDA also saw substantial growth. The company experienced strong performance across its brands, including Timex, Guess, and Versace. E-commerce channels recorded a 90% increase in sales.

items.title: Senco Gold Q4 Results: Profit skyrockets 151% to Rs 157 crore
items.description: Senco Gold has announced a significant profit jump of 151 percent for the fourth quarter. This surge is attributed to soaring gold prices and robust sales. The company saw its revenue climb by 45 percent. Retail sales reached an all-time high, boosted by wedding demand and an active old gold exchange program.
